rubric.role_summary: Senior brand experience role owning online and offline customer journeys, unboxing and product experience, customer insights, segmentation, and brand consistency for a skincare brand.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Senior brand experience role owning online and offline customer journeys, unboxing and product experience, customer insights, segmentation, and brand consistency for a skincare brand.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- 5+ years of experience in CX, brand marketing, or customer insights.
- Experience with customer segmentation, journey mapping, or CX reporting.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- Experience within beauty, lifestyle, or consumer brands.
- Additional European languages, such as German, French, Spanish, or Italian.
- Experience working closely with packaging design and production teams.
- Ability to translate data and customer feedback into actionable strategy and measurable outcomes.
- Experience managing cross-functional projects across marketing, product, creative, and operations.
- Experience owning segmentation, journey mapping, and CX reporting end-to-end.
- Some experience coaching or mentoring junior team members.
- Project management skills across parallel workstreams.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Accept any one of these geographic alternatives (OR): Greater Berlin, Germany area. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them. Hybrid work is based in one of these areas.
